items.description: On every left mouse press and release, logs the screen position, whether the pointer-over-UI check caught it, which UI element (if any) was picked there, and what world action (if any) it triggered. Off by default; the Editor forces it on at startup (see GameBootstrap).
On every hand-gathering task change, logs who, their old task, their new task, and why. Off by default; the Editor forces it on at startup (see GameBootstrap).
